field.name: ContentBindingMode
field.summary: Tracks whether content is statically bound or managed by a live session.

field.name: LiveContentStatus
field.summary: Tracks the current terminal or non-terminal state of live-bound content.

field.name: LiveContentFaultMessage
field.summary: Optional live-content fault message captured when a live binding faults.

method.name: op_Explicit
method.summary: Store stream in DataStreamItem.
method.returns: DataStreamItem created from Content.

method.name: op_Equality
method.summary: Equality Operator.
method.returns: True if DataStreamItems are equal.

method.name: op_Inequality
method.summary: Inequality Operator.
method.returns: True if DataStreamItems are not equal.

method.name: FromFile
method.summary: Create from file.
method.returns: Object created from file metadata.

method.name: GetContent
method.summary: Get the runtime-attached content stream for this item.
method.returns: The currently attached readable stream when content is bound in-memory; otherwise null.

method.name: GetContentStream
method.summary: Get a readable content stream for this item from the current in-memory binding or the bound file path.
method.returns: The attached readable in-memory stream when available; otherwise a newly opened read stream for the bound file when streamed file content is available; otherwise null.

method.name: GetContentBindingMode
method.summary: Get the current content binding mode.
method.returns: Current content binding mode.

method.name: GetLiveContentStatus
method.summary: Get the current live-content status.
method.returns: Current live-content status.

method.name: GetLiveContentFaultMessage
method.summary: Get the optional fault message associated with the live content state.
method.returns: Fault message when the live content is faulted; otherwise null.

method.name: BindLiveContent
method.summary: Bind a readable stream as live session-managed content.
method.returns: Returns true if live content binding succeeded.

method.name: CompleteLiveContent
method.summary: Mark live session-managed content as completed.
method.returns: Returns true if the live content state was updated.

method.name: AbortLiveContent
method.summary: Mark live session-managed content as aborted.
method.returns: Returns true if the live content state was updated.

method.name: FaultLiveContent
method.summary: Mark live session-managed content as faulted.
method.returns: Returns true if the live content state was updated.

method.name: CheckDataHash
method.summary: Validate the current content integrity state for file-backed DataStreamItem content.
method.returns: True when streamed content is bound to an existing file, is not live session-managed, and the current file content matches the stored content or encrypted-content integrity state; otherwise false.

method.name: SignData
method.summary: Sign supported DataStreamItem security fields.
method.param: Field to sign. `MetaData` is always supported. `Content` is supported only for file-backed streamed content and is not supported for live session-managed or in-memory-only content.
Security context used to issue the field assertion.
method.returns: The signed field key when signing succeeds; otherwise null.

method.name: EncryptData
method.summary: Encrypt file-backed DataStreamItem content in place.
method.param: Security context that defines the recipient set and protection metadata.
method.returns: True when the item is not locked, not already encrypted, not live session-managed, and has streamed content bound to an existing file that can be encrypted in place; otherwise false.

method.name: DecryptData
method.summary: Decrypt file-backed DataStreamItem content in place.
method.param: Security context used to decrypt the protected file content.
method.returns: True when the item is encrypted, not locked, not live session-managed, and has streamed content bound to an existing file that can be decrypted in place; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyData
method.summary: Verify supported DataStreamItem security fields against current item state.
method.param: Field to verify. `MetaData` is always supported. `Content` and `EncryptedData` are supported only for file-backed streamed content and are not supported for live session-managed or in-memory-only content.
Security context used to resolve and validate the field assertion signer.
method.returns: True when the requested supported field has a valid assertion and the current metadata or file-backed content state matches that assertion; otherwise false.

method.name: SetLiveContentTerminalState
method.summary: Apply a terminal live-content state transition for session-managed content.
method.param: Optional fault message stored when the terminal state is faulted.
method.returns: Returns true if the live content state transition was applied.

method.name: OnDeserialized
method.summary: Serialization Support.

method.name: Parse
method.summary: Parse DataStreamItem.
method.returns: Parsed DataStreamItem.

method.name: SetContent
method.summary: Attach or clear the in-memory content stream used by this item.
method.param: Readable content stream to attach. Null or unreadable streams clear the current in-memory content binding.
method.returns: Returns true when a readable stream is attached. Returns false when the item is locked, live session-managed, or the supplied stream is null or unreadable.

method.name: SetContentStreamed
method.summary: Enable or disable streamed-content mode for stream-backed or file-backed content.
method.param: True to enable streamed content mode; false to disable it.
method.returns: True when streamed mode is enabled from a readable in-memory stream or an existing bound file, or when it is disabled for file-backed content. Returns false when the item is locked, live session-managed, when no readable content source is available, or when disabling streamed mode while readable in-memory content is still attached.
